steps.name: 读取服务状态与上传配置
steps.script:
set -euo pipefail
umask 077
app='ytlabel'
version='4.0'
root="$OPS_INSTALL_ROOT"
unit="ops-app-${OPS_SOFTWARE_ID}.service"
container="sfops-${OPS_SOFTWARE_ID}"
service_user="ops${OPS_SOFTWARE_ID//-/}"
service_user="${service_user:0:27}"
fail() { printf '%s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
need() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null || fail "缺少依赖 $1，请先安装后重试"; }
[[ "$root" == /* && "$root" != / && ! -L "$root" ]] || fail '安装目录不安全'
check_owner() { [[ -f "$root/config/ops-owner" && "$(cat "$root/config/ops-owner")" == "$app:$OPS_SOFTWARE_ID" ]] || fail '安装目录归属不符，请核对原任务'; }
record_owner() { printf '%s\n' "$app:$OPS_SOFTWARE_ID" > "$root/config/ops-owner"; chmod 600 "$root/config/ops-owner"; }
owned_container() { [[ "$(docker inspect --format '{{index .Config.Labels "streamfusion.ops.software-id"}}' "$container")" == "$OPS_SOFTWARE_ID" ]] || fail '容器归属不符'; }

check_owner
state=$(systemctl show --property=ActiveState --value --no-pager "$OPS_SOFTWARE_LOCATOR")
case "$state" in active) state=运行中;; inactive) state=已停止;; failed) state=启动失败;; activating) state=启动中;; *) state=状态待确认;; esac
printf '服务状态：%s\n当前监听与上传配置：\n' "$state"
cat -- "$root/config/ytlabel.json"
printf '\n'

steps.name: 更新监听配置并重启服务
steps.script:
set -euo pipefail
umask 077
app='ytlabel'
version='4.0'
root="$OPS_INSTALL_ROOT"
unit="ops-app-${OPS_SOFTWARE_ID}.service"
container="sfops-${OPS_SOFTWARE_ID}"
service_user="ops${OPS_SOFTWARE_ID//-/}"
service_user="${service_user:0:27}"
fail() { printf '%s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
need() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null || fail "缺少依赖 $1，请先安装后重试"; }
[[ "$root" == /* && "$root" != / && ! -L "$root" ]] || fail '安装目录不安全'
check_owner() { [[ -f "$root/config/ops-owner" && "$(cat "$root/config/ops-owner")" == "$app:$OPS_SOFTWARE_ID" ]] || fail '安装目录归属不符，请核对原任务'; }
record_owner() { printf '%s\n' "$app:$OPS_SOFTWARE_ID" > "$root/config/ops-owner"; chmod 600 "$root/config/ops-owner"; }
owned_container() { [[ "$(docker inspect --format '{{index .Config.Labels "streamfusion.ops.software-id"}}' "$container")" == "$OPS_SOFTWARE_ID" ]] || fail '容器归属不符'; }

check_owner
config="$root/config/ytlabel.json"
backup="$root/config/ytlabel-network.previous.json"
[[ -f "$config" && ! -L "$config" ]] || fail '缺少本实例访问配置'
[[ ! -L "$backup" && ( ! -e "$backup" || -f "$backup" ) ]] || fail '配置备份位置异常'
grep -Fxq "Description=Ops ytlabel $OPS_SOFTWARE_ID" "/etc/systemd/system/$unit" || fail '服务单元归属不符'
python=$(cat "$root/config/python-binary")
"$python" -I - "$config" <<'PY'
import ipaddress, json, os, stat, sys, tempfile
config = sys.argv[1]
address = ipaddress.IPv4Address(os.environ['OPS_PARAM_BIND_ADDRESS'])
port = int(os.environ['OPS_PARAM_WEB_PORT'])
if address.is_multicast or not 1 <= port <= 65535:
    sys.exit('监听地址或端口无效')
metadata = os.stat(config, follow_symlinks=False)
if not stat.S_ISREG(metadata.st_mode) or metadata.st_size > 65536:
    sys.exit('访问配置不可读取')
with open(config, encoding='utf8') as source:
    settings = json.load(source)
if not isinstance(settings, dict) or not {'host', 'port', 'maxUploadMiB'} <= settings.keys():
    sys.exit('原访问配置不完整')
settings.update(host=str(address), port=port)
with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode='w', dir=os.path.dirname(config), prefix='.ytlabel-network-', delete=False, encoding='utf8') as output:
    temporary = output.name
    json.dump(settings, output)
os.chown(temporary, metadata.st_uid, metadata.st_gid)
os.chmod(temporary, stat.S_IMODE(metadata.st_mode))
os.replace(temporary, config + '.next')
PY
cp -p -- "$config" "$backup"
rollback() {
  trap - ERR
  cp -p -- "$backup" "$config"
  systemctl restart "$unit" || true
  fail '访问配置未生效，已恢复原配置，请查看运行日志'
}
trap rollback ERR
mv -- "$config.next" "$config"
systemctl restart "$unit"
host="$OPS_PARAM_BIND_ADDRESS"
[[ "$host" != 0.0.0.0 ]] || host=127.0.0.1
ready=false
for attempt in {1..30}; do
  if systemctl is-active --quiet "$unit" && curl --fail --silent --max-time 2 "http://$host:$OPS_PARAM_WEB_PORT/" | grep -qi 'ytlabel'; then ready=true; break; fi
  sleep 2
done
[[ "$ready" == true ]] || rollback
trap - ERR
printf '访问配置已生效：%s:%s\n' "$OPS_PARAM_BIND_ADDRESS" "$OPS_PARAM_WEB_PORT"

verifySteps.name: 验证访问地址与服务状态
verifySteps.script:
set -euo pipefail
umask 077
app='ytlabel'
version='4.0'
root="$OPS_INSTALL_ROOT"
unit="ops-app-${OPS_SOFTWARE_ID}.service"
container="sfops-${OPS_SOFTWARE_ID}"
service_user="ops${OPS_SOFTWARE_ID//-/}"
service_user="${service_user:0:27}"
fail() { printf '%s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
need() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null || fail "缺少依赖 $1，请先安装后重试"; }
[[ "$root" == /* && "$root" != / && ! -L "$root" ]] || fail '安装目录不安全'
check_owner() { [[ -f "$root/config/ops-owner" && "$(cat "$root/config/ops-owner")" == "$app:$OPS_SOFTWARE_ID" ]] || fail '安装目录归属不符，请核对原任务'; }
record_owner() { printf '%s\n' "$app:$OPS_SOFTWARE_ID" > "$root/config/ops-owner"; chmod 600 "$root/config/ops-owner"; }
owned_container() { [[ "$(docker inspect --format '{{index .Config.Labels "streamfusion.ops.software-id"}}' "$container")" == "$OPS_SOFTWARE_ID" ]] || fail '容器归属不符'; }

check_owner
python=$(cat "$root/config/python-binary")
"$python" -I - "$root/config/ytlabel.json" <<'PY'
import json, os, sys
with open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf8') as source:
    settings = json.load(source)
if settings['host'] != os.environ['OPS_PARAM_BIND_ADDRESS'] or settings['port'] != int(os.environ['OPS_PARAM_WEB_PORT']):
    sys.exit('访问配置与本次操作不一致')
PY
systemctl is-active --quiet "$unit" || fail '服务尚未运行'

[[ "$host" != 0.0.0.0 ]] || host=127.0.0.1
curl --fail --silent --max-time 3 "http://$host:$OPS_PARAM_WEB_PORT/" | grep -qi 'ytlabel' || fail '服务页面未就绪'
printf '%s\n' '访问配置与服务页面验证通过'

steps.name: 检查 Python、系统依赖与数据目录
steps.script:
set -euo pipefail
umask 077
app='ytlabel'
version='4.0'
root="$OPS_INSTALL_ROOT"
unit="ops-app-${OPS_SOFTWARE_ID}.service"
container="sfops-${OPS_SOFTWARE_ID}"
service_user="ops${OPS_SOFTWARE_ID//-/}"
service_user="${service_user:0:27}"
fail() { printf '%s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
need() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null || fail "缺少依赖 $1，请先安装后重试"; }
[[ "$root" == /* && "$root" != / && ! -L "$root" ]] || fail '安装目录不安全'
check_owner() { [[ -f "$root/config/ops-owner" && "$(cat "$root/config/ops-owner")" == "$app:$OPS_SOFTWARE_ID" ]] || fail '安装目录归属不符，请核对原任务'; }
record_owner() { printf '%s\n' "$app:$OPS_SOFTWARE_ID" > "$root/config/ops-owner"; chmod 600 "$root/config/ops-owner"; }
owned_container() { [[ "$(docker inspect --format '{{index .Config.Labels "streamfusion.ops.software-id"}}' "$container")" == "$OPS_SOFTWARE_ID" ]] || fail '容器归属不符'; }
create_service_user() {
  if getent passwd "$service_user" >/dev/null; then
    [[ "$(getent passwd "$service_user" | cut -d: -f6)" == "$root" ]] || fail '服务账号已被其他目录使用'
  else
    useradd --system --home-dir "$root" --no-create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin "$service_user"
  fi
  chown "$service_user:" "$root/data" "$root/logs"
  chown root:"$(id -gn "$service_user")" "$root"
  chmod 750 "$root" "$root/data" "$root/logs"
}
write_unit() {
  local path="/etc/systemd/system/$unit"
  [[ ! -e "$path" && ! -L "$path" ]] || fail '服务单元已存在'
  cat > "$path" <<EOF
[Unit]
Description=Ops $app $OPS_SOFTWARE_ID
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target
[Service]
Type=simple
User=$service_user
WorkingDirectory=$root
ExecStart=/bin/bash $root/bin/run
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
TimeoutStopSec=90
UMask=0027
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
LimitNOFILE=65536
MemoryMax=${OPS_MEMORY_MIB}M
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
  chmod 644 "$path"
  chmod 755 "$root/bin" "$root/bin/run"
  chmod 750 "$root/config"
  chown root:"$(id -gn "$service_user")" "$root" "$root/config"
  systemctl daemon-reload
  systemctl enable --now "$unit"
}

for command in systemctl tar sha256sum useradd runuser findmnt curl readlink; do need "$command"; done
[[ ! -e "$root/config/ops-owner" ]] || fail '已有安装记录，请先核对原任务'
systemd_version=$(systemctl --version | head -n 1 | awk '{print $2}')
[[ "$systemd_version" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$systemd_version" -ge 239 ]] || fail 'ytlabel 隔离运行需要 systemd 239 以上'
python=$(readlink -f "$OPS_PARAM_PYTHON_BINARY")
case "$python" in /home/*|/root/*|/run/user/*) fail '服务隔离禁止使用用户主目录中的 Python，请选择系统或 Ops 运行目录的解释器';; esac
[[ -x "$python" && "$python" =~ ^/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+$ ]] || fail '请选择可执行的 Python 3.9 或 3.10'
"$python" -I - <<'PY'
import sys
if sys.version_info[:2] not in [(3, 9), (3, 10)]:
    sys.exit('上游 OpenCV 固定依赖需要 Python 3.9 或 3.10，请选择对应解释器路径')
try:
    import venv, ensurepip
except ImportError:
    sys.exit('所选 Python 缺少 venv/ensurepip，请先安装对应的 python-venv 系统组件')
from ctypes import CDLL
for name in ['libGL.so.1', 'libglib-2.0.so.0', 'libgthread-2.0.so.0']:
    try:
        CDLL(name)
    except OSError:
        sys.exit('上游 opencv-python 缺少系统库 ' + name + '，请先由管理员安装对应系统依赖')
PY
[[ "$OPS_PARAM_MAX_UPLOAD_MIB" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$OPS_PARAM_MAX_UPLOAD_MIB" -ge 1 && "$OPS_PARAM_MAX_UPLOAD_MIB" -le 16384 ]] || fail '上传上限须为 1 至 16384 MiB'
source_directory=${OPS_PARAM_SOURCE_DIRECTORY:-}
if [[ -n "$source_directory" ]]; then
  [[ "$source_directory" =~ ^/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+$ && "$source_directory" != / && -d "$source_directory" && "$(readlink -f "$source_directory")" == "$source_directory" ]] || fail '素材目录须为已存在且不含符号链接的完整目录'
  [[ "$source_directory" != "$root" && "$source_directory" != "$root/"* && "$root" != "$source_directory/"* ]] || fail '只读素材目录不能与本实例安装目录重叠'
fi
record_owner
create_service_user
runuser -u "$service_user" -- "$python" -I -c 'import venv, ensurepip' || fail '服务账号无法读取所选 Python，请选择可读的系统或 Ops 运行目录解释器'
group=$(id -gn "$service_user")
chown root:"$group" "$root/config"
chmod 750 "$root/config"
printf '%s\n' "$python" > "$root/config/python-binary"
chmod 640 "$root/config/python-binary"
chown root:"$group" "$root/config/python-binary"
printf '%s\n' 'ytlabel 上游无登录认证，请在受限网络使用。'

steps.name: 核验固定源码并安装独立依赖
steps.script:
set -euo pipefail
umask 077
app='ytlabel'
version='4.0'
root="$OPS_INSTALL_ROOT"
unit="ops-app-${OPS_SOFTWARE_ID}.service"
container="sfops-${OPS_SOFTWARE_ID}"
service_user="ops${OPS_SOFTWARE_ID//-/}"
service_user="${service_user:0:27}"
fail() { printf '%s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
need() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null || fail "缺少依赖 $1，请先安装后重试"; }
[[ "$root" == /* && "$root" != / && ! -L "$root" ]] || fail '安装目录不安全'
check_owner() { [[ -f "$root/config/ops-owner" && "$(cat "$root/config/ops-owner")" == "$app:$OPS_SOFTWARE_ID" ]] || fail '安装目录归属不符，请核对原任务'; }
record_owner() { printf '%s\n' "$app:$OPS_SOFTWARE_ID" > "$root/config/ops-owner"; chmod 600 "$root/config/ops-owner"; }
owned_container() { [[ "$(docker inspect --format '{{index .Config.Labels "streamfusion.ops.software-id"}}' "$container")" == "$OPS_SOFTWARE_ID" ]] || fail '容器归属不符'; }

check_owner
python=$(cat "$root/config/python-binary")
group=$(id -gn "$service_user")
[[ ! -e "$root/runtime" ]] || fail '程序目录已存在，请先核对原任务'
install -d -m 750 -o root -g "$group" "$root/runtime"
bundle="$root/work/ytlabel-material"
[[ ! -e "$bundle" ]] || fail '材料暂存目录已存在，请先核对原任务'
install -d -m 700 "$bundle"
cat > "$root/work/ytlabel-extract.py" <<'PY'
import hashlib, re, shutil, sys, tarfile
from pathlib import Path

archive, destination, mode = Path(sys.argv[1]), Path(sys.argv[2]), sys.argv[3]
prefix = 'ytlabel-08930fd95fe0ea0b407346ebb2d10929e5b45245/'
def digest(path):
    result = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open('rb') as source:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: source.read(1 << 20), b''):
            result.update(chunk)
    return result.hexdigest()

with tarfile.open(archive, 'r:gz') as bundle:
    entries = bundle.getmembers()
    if len(entries) > 1024 or sum(item.size for item in entries) > (2 << 30):
        sys.exit('安装材料展开后过大或文件过多')
    paths = set()
    files = {}
    for item in entries:
        name = item.name
        if mode == 'source':
            if name == prefix.rstrip('/') and item.isdir():
                continue
            if not name.startswith(prefix):
                sys.exit('源码包目录与固定版本不一致')
            name = name[len(prefix):]
        if not name:
            continue
        if name in paths or not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_.+/-]+', name) or name.startswith('/') or any(part in ['', '.', '..'] for part in name.rstrip('/').split('/')):
            sys.exit('安装包包含不安全路径或重复文件')
        paths.add(name)
        if not (item.isdir() or item.isfile()):
            sys.exit('安装包不能包含链接或特殊文件')
        if mode == 'offline' and not (name in ['source.tar.gz', 'SHA256SUMS', 'wheelhouse'] or re.fullmatch(r'wheelhouse/[A-Za-z0-9_.+-]+\.whl', name)):
            sys.exit('离线包应包含 source.tar.gz、wheelhouse/*.whl 和 SHA256SUMS')
        target = destination / name
        if item.isdir():
            target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        else:
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            with bundle.extractfile(item) as source, target.open('xb') as output:
                shutil.copyfileobj(source, output, 1 << 20)
            files[name] = target
    if mode == 'offline':
        if 'source.tar.gz' not in files or 'SHA256SUMS' not in files or not any(name.endswith('.whl') for name in files):
            sys.exit('离线包缺少固定源码、依赖 wheel 或摘要清单')
        seen = set()
        for line in files['SHA256SUMS'].read_text(encoding='ascii').splitlines():
            match = re.fullmatch(r'([a-fA-F0-9]{64})  ([A-Za-z0-9_.+/-]+)', line)
            if not match or match[2] in seen or match[2] not in files or match[2] == 'SHA256SUMS':
                sys.exit('离线摘要清单有重复或不匹配条目')
            seen.add(match[2])
            if digest(files[match[2]]) != match[1].lower():
                sys.exit('离线文件摘要不一致：' + match[2])
        if seen != set(files) - {'SHA256SUMS'}:
            sys.exit('离线摘要清单未完整覆盖所有文件')

PY
if [[ "$OPS_SOURCE" == ONLINE ]]; then
  curl --fail --location --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 180 --max-filesize 5242880 --retry 2 --output "$bundle/source.tar.gz" 'https://codeload.github.com/yuturuishi/ytlabel/tar.gz/08930fd95fe0ea0b407346ebb2d10929e5b45245'
else
  "$python" -I "$root/work/ytlabel-extract.py" "$OPS_ARTIFACT_PATH" "$bundle" offline
fi
printf '%s  %s\n' '5c318684852128c812d13581a561aedbed36998b43d74c10f6798f37aee7205e' "$bundle/source.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
"$python" -I "$root/work/ytlabel-extract.py" "$bundle/source.tar.gz" "$root/runtime/source" source
readable_material=("$root/runtime/source")
if [[ "$OPS_SOURCE" == ARCHIVE ]]; then
  mv -- "$bundle/wheelhouse" "$root/runtime/wheelhouse"
  readable_material+=("$root/runtime/wheelhouse")
fi
chown -hR root:"$group" "${readable_material[@]}"
find "${readable_material[@]}" -type d -exec chmod 750 {} +
find "${readable_material[@]}" -type f -exec chmod 640 {} +
install -d -m 750 -o "$service_user" -g "$group" "$root/runtime/venv"
runuser -u "$service_user" -- "$python" -I -m venv "$root/runtime/venv"
pip=("$root/runtime/venv/bin/python" -I -m pip --isolated --disable-pip-version-check install --no-cache-dir --only-binary=:all: --retries 2 --timeout 30)
if [[ "$OPS_SOURCE" == ONLINE ]]; then
  runuser -u "$service_user" -- "${pip[@]}" --index-url https://pypi.org/simple -r "$root/runtime/source/requirements.txt"
else
  runuser -u "$service_user" -- "${pip[@]}" --no-index --find-links "$root/runtime/wheelhouse" -r "$root/runtime/source/requirements.txt"
fi
runuser -u "$service_user" -- "$root/runtime/venv/bin/python" -I -m pip --isolated --disable-pip-version-check check
runuser -u "$service_user" -- "$root/runtime/venv/bin/python" -I -c 'import cv2, flask, flask_socketio, simple_websocket; print("Python 依赖已就绪")'
chown -hR root:"$group" "$root/runtime/venv"
find "$root/runtime/venv" -type d -exec chmod g+rx,o-rwx {} +
find "$root/runtime/venv" -type f -exec chmod g+r,o-rwx {} +

steps.name: 配置上传上限、素材目录并启动
steps.script:
set -euo pipefail
umask 077
app='ytlabel'
version='4.0'
root="$OPS_INSTALL_ROOT"
unit="ops-app-${OPS_SOFTWARE_ID}.service"
container="sfops-${OPS_SOFTWARE_ID}"
service_user="ops${OPS_SOFTWARE_ID//-/}"
service_user="${service_user:0:27}"
fail() { printf '%s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
need() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null || fail "缺少依赖 $1，请先安装后重试"; }
[[ "$root" == /* && "$root" != / && ! -L "$root" ]] || fail '安装目录不安全'
check_owner() { [[ -f "$root/config/ops-owner" && "$(cat "$root/config/ops-owner")" == "$app:$OPS_SOFTWARE_ID" ]] || fail '安装目录归属不符，请核对原任务'; }
record_owner() { printf '%s\n' "$app:$OPS_SOFTWARE_ID" > "$root/config/ops-owner"; chmod 600 "$root/config/ops-owner"; }
owned_container() { [[ "$(docker inspect --format '{{index .Config.Labels "streamfusion.ops.software-id"}}' "$container")" == "$OPS_SOFTWARE_ID" ]] || fail '容器归属不符'; }

check_owner
python=$(cat "$root/config/python-binary")
group=$(id -gn "$service_user")
"$python" -I - "$root/config/ytlabel.json" <<'PY'
import json, os, sys
from ipaddress import IPv4Address
host = os.environ['OPS_BIND_ADDRESS']
IPv4Address(host)
port = int(os.environ['OPS_HOST_PORT'])
size = int(os.environ['OPS_PARAM_MAX_UPLOAD_MIB'])
if not 1 <= port <= 65535 or not 1 <= size <= 16384:
    sys.exit('端口或上传大小超出范围')
with open(sys.argv[1], 'x', encoding='utf8') as output:
    json.dump({'host': host, 'port': port, 'maxUploadMiB': size}, output)
PY
cat > "$root/bin/ytlabel-launch.py" <<'PY'
import importlib, json, os, sys
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
settings = json.loads((root / 'config' / 'ytlabel.json').read_text(encoding='utf8'))
os.chdir(root / 'data')
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / 'runtime' / 'source'))
upstream = importlib.import_module('app')
upstream.app.config['MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH'] = settings['maxUploadMiB'] * 1024 * 1024
upstream.socketio.run(upstream.app, host=settings['host'], port=settings['port'], debug=False, use_reloader=False, allow_unsafe_werkzeug=True)

PY
cat > "$root/bin/run" <<EOF
#!/bin/bash
exec '$root/runtime/venv/bin/python' -I '$root/bin/ytlabel-launch.py'
EOF
unit_path="/etc/systemd/system/$unit"
[[ ! -e "$unit_path" && ! -L "$unit_path" ]] || fail '服务单元已存在'
source_directory=${OPS_PARAM_SOURCE_DIRECTORY:-}
if [[ -n "$source_directory" ]]; then
  [[ -d "$source_directory" && "$(readlink -f "$source_directory")" == "$source_directory" && "$source_directory" =~ ^/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+$ ]] || fail '素材目录已变化或不可读取'
  [[ ! -e "$root/data/uploads/samples" ]] || fail '只读图片挂载位置已存在'
  install -d -m 750 -o "$service_user" -g "$group" "$root/data/uploads" "$root/data/uploads/samples"
fi
cat > "$unit_path" <<EOF
[Unit]
Description=Ops ytlabel $OPS_SOFTWARE_ID
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target
[Service]
Type=simple
User=$service_user
Group=$group
WorkingDirectory=$root/data
ExecStart=/bin/bash $root/bin/run
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
TimeoutStopSec=60
UMask=0027
NoNewPrivileges=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=true
PrivateTmp=true
ReadWritePaths=$root/data $root/logs
MemoryMax=${OPS_MEMORY_MIB}M
LimitNOFILE=65536
EOF
if [[ -n "$source_directory" ]]; then
  printf 'BindReadOnlyPaths=%s:%s/data/uploads/samples\nExecStartPre=/usr/bin/test -r %s/data/uploads/samples\nExecStartPre=/usr/bin/test -x %s/data/uploads/samples\n' "$source_directory" "$root" "$root" "$root" >> "$unit_path"
fi
printf '\n[Install]\nWantedBy=multi-user.target\n' >> "$unit_path"
chmod 644 "$unit_path"
chmod 750 "$root/bin" "$root/bin/run" "$root/bin/ytlabel-launch.py"
chown root:"$group" "$root/bin" "$root/bin/run" "$root/bin/ytlabel-launch.py" "$root/config/ytlabel.json"
chmod 640 "$root/config/ytlabel.json"
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now "$unit"

steps.name: 验证标注界面与服务状态
steps.script:
set -euo pipefail
umask 077
app='ytlabel'
version='4.0'
root="$OPS_INSTALL_ROOT"
unit="ops-app-${OPS_SOFTWARE_ID}.service"
container="sfops-${OPS_SOFTWARE_ID}"
service_user="ops${OPS_SOFTWARE_ID//-/}"
service_user="${service_user:0:27}"
fail() { printf '%s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
need() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null || fail "缺少依赖 $1，请先安装后重试"; }
[[ "$root" == /* && "$root" != / && ! -L "$root" ]] || fail '安装目录不安全'
check_owner() { [[ -f "$root/config/ops-owner" && "$(cat "$root/config/ops-owner")" == "$app:$OPS_SOFTWARE_ID" ]] || fail '安装目录归属不符，请核对原任务'; }
record_owner() { printf '%s\n' "$app:$OPS_SOFTWARE_ID" > "$root/config/ops-owner"; chmod 600 "$root/config/ops-owner"; }
owned_container() { [[ "$(docker inspect --format '{{index .Config.Labels "streamfusion.ops.software-id"}}' "$container")" == "$OPS_SOFTWARE_ID" ]] || fail '容器归属不符'; }

check_owner
for attempt in {1..60}; do
  if systemctl is-active --quiet "$unit" && curl --fail --silent --max-time 3 "http://$OPS_BIND_ADDRESS:$OPS_HOST_PORT/" | grep -qi 'ytlabel'; then
    printf '%s\n' 'ytlabel 4.0 已启动，上传限制和只读素材目录已写入本实例配置'
    exit 0
  fi
  sleep 2
done
fail 'ytlabel 未就绪，请查看运行日志；核对 Python 版本、系统库和素材目录读取权限'

steps.name: 卸载程序并保留标注数据
steps.script:
set -euo pipefail
umask 077
app='ytlabel'
version='4.0'
root="$OPS_INSTALL_ROOT"
unit="ops-app-${OPS_SOFTWARE_ID}.service"
container="sfops-${OPS_SOFTWARE_ID}"
service_user="ops${OPS_SOFTWARE_ID//-/}"
service_user="${service_user:0:27}"
fail() { printf '%s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
need() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null || fail "缺少依赖 $1，请先安装后重试"; }
[[ "$root" == /* && "$root" != / && ! -L "$root" ]] || fail '安装目录不安全'
check_owner() { [[ -f "$root/config/ops-owner" && "$(cat "$root/config/ops-owner")" == "$app:$OPS_SOFTWARE_ID" ]] || fail '安装目录归属不符，请核对原任务'; }
record_owner() { printf '%s\n' "$app:$OPS_SOFTWARE_ID" > "$root/config/ops-owner"; chmod 600 "$root/config/ops-owner"; }
owned_container() { [[ "$(docker inspect --format '{{index .Config.Labels "streamfusion.ops.software-id"}}' "$container")" == "$OPS_SOFTWARE_ID" ]] || fail '容器归属不符'; }
check_no_mounts() {
  local path="$1" target
  need findmnt
  findmnt --raw --noheadings --output TARGET > "$root/work/mount-targets" || fail '无法确认数据目录内的挂载点'
  while IFS= read -r target; do
    [[ "$target" != "$path" && "$target" != "$path/"* ]] || fail "目录包含挂载点，请管理员先核对：$target"
  done < "$root/work/mount-targets"
}

check_owner
check_no_mounts "$root/runtime"
path="/etc/systemd/system/$unit"
[[ -f "$path" && ! -L "$path" ]] || fail '缺少原服务单元，请先核对卸载范围'
grep -Fxq "Description=Ops ytlabel $OPS_SOFTWARE_ID" "$path" || fail '服务单元归属不符'
systemctl disable --now "$unit"
rm -- "$path"
systemctl daemon-reload
rm -rf -- "$root/runtime"
rm -f -- "$root/bin/run" "$root/bin/ytlabel-launch.py"
printf '%s\n' 'ytlabel 已卸载，标注数据和配置已保留；外部素材目录未删除'
